title: Puma, Titan and Scout — produced vehicle review E
notes: Actual Godot inspection and connected gameplay captures of nine authored vehicle LOD exports. The original images and outcome receipts are copied unchanged; click images for full resolution.

Close views are staged native inspections. Gameplay uses three native clients per case on Sunscar Convoy / Combined Arms and ordinary source simulation. Software-rendered gameplay disables shadows and uses 50% 3D resolution; these captures do not establish full-quality GPU performance or human handling feel.

Titan UI150 retains the original compact screenshot, including clipped bottom instructions. A source follow-up is assigned; this gallery does not claim that HUD issue is corrected. Vehicle package promotion and final Windows/Linux verification remain pending.
